multiplicity: Holm4 for four prespecified primary comparisons; two-sided
bootstrap: 10000 paired template-cluster draws; average rotations then fixed prompt variants within item; variants not independent sample units
induction_target: anger at decision makers; moral disgust at procedure, never a KoBBQ social group
certainty_definition: announced outcome probability 100%; not proof of subjective confidence
positive_definition: one composite happiness/contentment/joy condition, not three separately identified emotions
limits: Emotional instructions and associated semantic appraisals change together
Decision certainty and certainty about the KoBBQ answer are distinct
Disgust induction can overlap anger; require separate checks
Certainty fixed in all cells: cannot estimate a certainty main effect versus uncertainty
Original UN/FA measurements cannot be reused under these new prompts
primary_p_method: Two-sided centered-null cluster-bootstrap approximation with plus-one correction; Holm4; not the historical sign-tail p estimator
